reviews.text: Great, kind people

We needed to share how happy we are with Doctor Whitfield, and all of the Forest Glen Animal Hospital staff. Our four year old Great Dane recently had surgery for Mast Cell cancer and Doctor Whitfield was so kind and compassionate with us and our girl. She went above and beyond for us, and it meant the world to us, because we love our dog more than the world. With every single thing that came up with our dog, they were so fast and helpful and above all kind as we were a mess. The surgery was beyond a success, and is healing beautifully. We are so grateful to you all! Thank you!

They take very special care of both of my Great Danes!  They’ve been wonderful - even during a pandemic!
Now the caring and professionalism in caring for our precious dog keeps us coming to Forest Glen for all our veterinary needs!
Thank you so much, Nina!
Very upfront about cost and handled our persnickety male cat fabulously.

The staff, vet tech and Dr. were all very welcoming. Care team and Dr. took the time to answer all of my questions regarding my new puppy and my senior dog. They treated my dogs like they were their own.
Attention from receptionist, assistant, and Dr were great. Dr and assistant answered all my questions and provided helpful information. Sent me home with a good puppy information package.
I've been going to Forest Glen for 10 years.  I've always felt confident in the care given to my dogs.  Dr. Whitfield is really wonderful
They understood the assignment 🥹🥹 …
Short wait. Helpful staff. Focused doctor. All concerns addressed. Very tuned in to comfort of dog. Dr. Whitfield even got on the floor with my pup who was fearful of the exam table.

I’ve been going to Forest Glen Animal Hospital since 2006. COVID threw us all a curveball but we got by. (I totally understand the mask protocols)(and understand what it’s like to deal with the public) The Veterinarians and the vet techs have always been empathetic and caring patient and understanding it’s not cheep being a dog/cat owner but I know he is in great hands.
Great experience. Everyone there knows your dog as soon as you walk in the door. The people there also care about your pet as if it were their's.

I wanted to say thank you so much to DR.Jordan Whitfield I brought in my 9 year old cane corso who had right sided heart failure. It was really hard to say goodbye since he was my first dog and my best friend. She was so caring and I felt like she understood our bond while I had went to other vets saying just to put him down but we weren’t ready my goal wasn’t just to keep him going and in pain, we just wanted more time and to keep him comfortable until I knew for sure it was time. I didn’t feel judged and she always made time for him. RIP my best friend.

Dr Gilbert, Carrie, and Katherine really took great care of our little “”Buddy”
yesterday during his annual visit!

Had a very pleasant first visit with Dr. Gilbert and staff! They were very helpful and understanding as they offered multiple treatment plans and options for what will work best for my dog. I'm very pleased and will gladly return for future visits!
Brought my greyhound for his first visit. Staff were helpful and friendly. Dr. Barichello explained everything and got a prompt response for his fecal results. So far so good!
Very good service. Employees were great!!
Timely- both the vet and the tech were professional and treated my dog with kindness!

Staff is diligent and friendly. Munchkin was greeted right away and babied the entire time. Veterinarian was gentle, informative and presented options that best suited the overall health of my dog. They have been going above and beyond since we have been going.

Forest Glen Animal Hospital has the friendliest staff, and they have been so great with my "spicy" rescue ever since I got her.  Vet visits are pretty stressful for my dog but the doctor and staff have taken great notes about what does and what doesn't work.  They've been great about trying to make each visit as not-stressful as possible.
I had a pleasant experience with Rosie's appointment with the veterinarian doctor.
Thank you for Helping my Rottweiler 🙏
our 2 dogs loved the vet and tech

We're glad you had a positive experience at Forest Glen Animal Hospital, Marilyn. If you have any concerns or feedback, feel free to reach out to us at (773) 283-2443. Thank you for choosing us for your pet's care.

When I woke up i notice my dog was bleeding from her private part. I was so scared because I didn’t know where to take her. I had visited to many vet clinics in 12 years and I haven’t like them. And they just charged me a lot for nothing. I was more frustrated because I didn’t have a place to trust. I started searching and i saw this vet clinic a read the reviews and I went. I didn’t have an appointment but they took me right away, very kind. I could see they really care about my dog. They explained to me very clear what they gonna do and gave me options if the first treatment doesn’t work,  they will do something else. I felt so safe and when they gave me the cost I was so impressed because I didn’t feel abused like other clinics. My dog is responding very well with the first option they gave me. I will come back because i feel sexure here. Thanknyou so much
Vet and vet tech always take the time to listen to my concerns and provide me with clear next steps.
The Forest Glen Animal Hospital is such a comfort to take my dog to. Great patience and always feel like my questions are answered.
To start off with Amber at the front desk was horrible. So disappointing.  Plus I came in and the vet was so disappointing.
Friendly neighborhood practice.  My dogs are treated well here, and the Vet/staff are kind and accommodating.

The vet here wrote the wrong prescription for my dog. I went to various pharmacies, spent hours doing this, to be told by them they had no idea what to do with the rx. We delayed treatment for our dog who has pneumonia because we were unable to find a pharmacy capable of filling out the wrong rx. I finally called the vet and said I don't think it's right. Only at THAT point did they realize their mistake.

They had the receptionist apologize to me, but not the doctor. When I asked for an apology from the doctor, here's the email I got back: "While we understand it was upsetting to have an error in a written prescription, our hospital immediately apologized and corrected the error. Your request is inappropriate and is emphatically denied. We will send full records to Bramer. We wish you and Violet all the best. This will be the final communication from our hospital."

Classless and cowardly. 1 star. Do NOT take animals you care about here.

EDIT: In their response they say "the energy I brought was not appropriate to the situation." I said, and I quote: "I would appreciate an apology from the vet who wrote the wrong prescription."
The person running this office is totally unhinged.
Great appointment availability.  Clean office and kind staff.  Each employee took the time to listen and give thorough explanations.
Best vets and staff in northern Chicago. Hands down. Love them.
LOVE Dr. Gilbert!! Great explanations of care, fun and positive - I felt our animals are in the best care - have been goin to Forest Glen Animal Hospital for 13 years.  Thank you!

My 9 yr old pit bull has been coming here for years and the entire staff has been great with her especially since she has a lot of anxiety going to the vet. Dr. Whitfield and the vet techs have always found a way to work with her(dog friendly spray cheese, whip cream and treats) and provide us with treatment options without feeling pushy about course of treatement. Appreciate the transparency and conveying cost before starting treatment. Opyll gives 5 paws up
Been coming here for 15 years, this place is great. Everyone is always friendly, they go above and beyond to help you out. And the place is always clean.

They might treat your pet alright!  But they really need to work on how they treat humans.  My family deserves more respect than what you gave us today!  No!  I will not take my wife’s information out of emergency contacts. How is this a solution?  What?

This location says that they are a locally and family owned on their website but they are owned by a corporation. I just talked with the staff who confirmed this. Very deceitful as I try to only do business with local companies. Luckily there is one not too far from here in Sauganash.
Nice vet practice close to us.  They’re very efficient with appointments and their techs are always super nice.  I trust them to take care of my cats’ health!

My dog Rollie has a history with this hospital  when I adopted him from a rescue shelter 10 months ago. He recently had an injury a couple of days ago and I was able after I adopted .They were able to look at him right away I didn’t care about the cost, the service is more important to me ,it was more important that they took care of him. No matter the cost. My dog Rollie is my family.
Dr Whitfield is the best!
very nice experience
Great service wonderfull veterinarians.
Everyone was friendly and made sure I had all of the information I needed. My two cats were relaxed and may even have enjoyed their visit just a teensy bit.
All good! Doctors are nice and kind to our dog - and we like the location !
Very compassionate and knowledgeable doctors and staff.
Excellent service.

I had a great visit with the veterinarian and she took my care of my dog with swift compassion. (She needed swift because she was nervous) I appreciate everything you do for my girl.
Thanks again!
This is a terrific vet clinic.

Being new to the area, I needed to make a first time and urgent visit to Forest Glen Animal Hospital for end of life care for my beloved dog. They got me in on the same day. Every person I interacted with was amazingly compassionate and helpful. For a very sad day, I was very grateful to have been at this clinic. Would highly suggest and will definitely return when we bring a new pet into our family.
So fast and lovely. Everyone is quite kind.

Save your money. Find another vet that doesn't gorge you on every visit.
I've been a customer/client for many years. I've had three different Golden's that they have cared for thru the years.
I always  thought they were expensive, but convenient location, and home town vet kept me around.
Anyway my last visit was two weeks ago. It cost me about $500.
Primary due to yearly vaccinations, no problem here.
But when I asked about my dog's ear infection. Which they confirmed was a yeast infection.
They gave me two options,
I could treat the ears myself, or they can use a medication that needs no attention from me for 4 weeks.
I went with the 4 week option.

Here I am two weeks later, and they want to charge me again to address the dogs ear.
I could imagine that the bill would have been at least $200, with new office visit, lab research.... blah, blah blah.
I walked out.

Fool me once, shame on me.
Fool me twice..... you lost my business.

The doctor and staff were professional, timely and effective in treating our cat. Additional treatments were offered and discussed, but not presented as mandatory. Pricing for all services was reasonable.
2 days before appointment I have received messages if I be late I have to paid 80 to 100$ Fine. Dr haven't even show up for a appointment  beouse a was coming late 😂 no one paid me $100 lol or 80 😂
Best experience ever! Dr. Gilbert is the best!

I love this group of Veterinarians & helpful staff.  I trust that they are thorough in diagnosis & treatment of my beloved pets.  Easy to get an appointment & extremely knowledgeable, professional & great care for our pets.
Best care for our large lovable Ajax Plott Hound.

I see all the comments about how polite and nice the staff is and honestly, they are.

However, none of that matters if the medical staff is incompetent in actual medicine. If they do know about medicine, then they lack the ability to explain to the pet family how to best help treat our furry family members.

My girl Lola, had to be put down because Forest Glen failed to act accurately and efficiently on an auto immune disease (their diagnosis) that was supposedly very common to her breed. If it was so common, why didn't they help her by describing to me what happens if untreated or if unattended immediately? They made it seem as it could be treated later and we could treat the  anxiety and allergy first. They failed to tell me that we should not delay the medication for the immune disease at the time. Instead, they were pushing for blood work and stool test that were not needed. The story is too long to put in here and too sad for me to continue writing.

I came to this clinic from Portage Park Vet clinic because they were just about the money grab. Turns out Forest Glen is the same. Just push the test and med sales and disregard actually guiding family members on what needs to be done. Probably to afraid of losing the medication sales on the other two issues.

I would NOT recommend either one.

My girl was 9 years old and might have lived another 2-3 years, but the delay just got her to the point were she had no quality of life.

Good luck everyone

My 4yo tabby, Yufi, had a wonderful experience getting her shots. I have never seen her so loving towards vet staff before! Cats are excellent judges of character. We have never felt pressured to do anything we weren’t comfortable with financially and have consistently experienced quality care. I’m so glad we made the switch!
My puppy was happy going in and happy going out so 2 thumbs up from w
If I could give 0 stars i would .
Dr. Gilbert is wonderful. I have been taking my babies there for the past 25 years.
Kind, compassionate, and professional. Thanks for taking care of Remi today!

At this point I've been to several vets on the North & Northwest side and Forest Glen is, without question, the absolute best. I have never once been dissatisfied with the treatment my cats have gotten there over the many years. Every doctor they employ is as knowledgeable, friendly, patient, kind and compassionate as the last. I can't say enough good things about this place.

They take their time with your animal and treat each pet with delighted affection, as if it's their own. They are very attuned to each individual animal's personality and needs. They are incredibly good at recordkeeping and diligent about follow-ups - you'd swear you were their only patient, the amount of individual attention they give to you before, during, and after your appointment. They have caught things other vets have missed. They're completely understanding, offer you several options, and let you ask as many questions as you want in a totally safe and non-judgmental space. Even the administrative staff is great - so friendly and sweet, so efficient and on top of things.

The confidence they instill in me that my babies are getting the best possible care is invaluable. Yes, they're kinda costly, but you're unlikely to find a vet in the area that isn't. I've been a client of theirs for about 15 years now and am only just now thinking to leave this review - they deserve all the praise they get. Thanks for everything, Forest Glen staff!!
Always very kind to my grumpy Tiger
Loved the nurses,  the doctor was exceptional. Hopefully, all is well when the results arrive.

We recently brought our two cats in for a wellness check. The entire process was chaotic and unprofessional.

Points of issue were:
-Technicians being confused about what was being asked (and poor communication both with us and with the veterinarian)
-The desk clerks having zero understanding of the billing (as well as a mysterious charge and how it could have gotten there before we even visited)
-A very rushed and inattentive veterinarian who straight up forgot to even address several concerns we had with one of the cats (even after we inquired a second and even a third time during the visit, we couldn't get a straight answer)
-Upsell, upsell, upsell! The only real time they spent on things was definitely when trying to upsell services and/or tests.

Honestly, a very sour experience dealing with a business that seems to care more about getting you in and out and billing as much as possible while you're there. Frustrating. I will not be back and will warn everyone in my neighborhood against going to this particular clinic. There are plenty around, so do yourself a favor and count them out at Forest Glen.

Vets and vet technicians are terrific. They seem understaffed, though; they often have to close early due to unexpected absences.

Their emails requesting pet medical information are downright unfriendly; they actually mention hounding clients to submit the forms. This doesn't seem like a good way to set a pleasant tone. Things used to be better in this regard; I don't know what changed.

The staff were kind and patient and were gentle to my anxious dog. After my dog got dental surgery from them, I was worried that he wasn’t recovering well, but they offered free follow-up check ups and cleared up all my concerns. The vet was very thorough in answering my questions.
My animal was a new patient with health issues. Everyone was so kind, helpful and helped us get answers to remedy the issue. Loved their kindness and professionalism.
The most kind and professional vet I have ever been to
Friendly caring staff always great with my pets
Great professional service and a warm passionate welcome and care.
The staff was very welcoming, professional and was very helpful with all are questions.

Very friendly staff and clean inside. Vets and Doctors explain everything thoroughly and are transparent about pricing and recommendations for your pet. They don’t push any other vaccines or tests that you do not want. Excellent place.
Great place!
We are delighted to see you had a positive experience at Forest Glen Animal Hospital. Thank you for your wonderful feedback.
Warm greeting, lovely tech, good energy vet.
We're delighted to hear about your positive experience at Forest Glen Animal Hospital. Thank you for sharing your feedback.
We're ecstatic to hear you had a positive experience at our hospital. Thank you for choosing Forest Glen Animal Hospital!

I brought my Kitty Milo for the first time about a year ago for a medical concern and staff and Dr.  were very friendly and supportive.  I had my cat neutered and vaccinated and have been pleased with the service. My cat recently had an ear infection and was well treated.  I use to live 3 minutes away from the hospital but I moved further northwest of the city and will continue to bring Milo for his care.  Thank you to all the staff for being there.  I wish doctors that treat people were caring and nice as Vets.
I ordered a prescription refit for my dog and it was ready within an hour. Great service.
Thank you, Brian, for your review. Holly is such a good girl, and we're always happy to se her!
I asked about getting my rabbit’s nails trimmed, but they don’t see exotic animals. Staff were helpful and kind on the phone

I have been going to Forest Glen for the past 20 years.  My most current visit was for testing.  The staff, techs and Dr. were responsive to an immediate care situation. Dr. Traci Gilbert is caring compassionate and thorough in explaining exactly the what and why = Diagnosis and treatment each step of the exam,

Really great experience. This is the 3rd vet I have tried in the area and I am so happy with this vet! Clean office, friendly helpful staff. The Dr was wonderful and thorough with my dog’s exam and made sure to explain everything in detail to me. I was given a quote for a dental cleaning and that was explained to me in detail as well. Will definitely be using them as my vet from now on!

Best animal hospital! We love Dr. Gilbert! She is amazing - so thorough, patient, and kind. Thorough and understandable explanations for everything. Vet technicians (we had Rebecca yesterday) always so gentle and kind - take time to get to know pets; knowledgeable and confident. They include us with all options for pets' care. I feel lucky to have our pet care there. Thank you to this amazing staff!

Forest Glen is the best; the staff members are all amazing. They are so caring and helpful with my fur baby. We have taken each of our dogs to them in turn for years, and they have been with us for every moment, including the heartbreaking ones. There is no vet practice I would trust more.

As other reviewers have mentioned. Brenda has a major attitude. When asked why I haven’t been able to talk to a vet about my questions and why I keep having to go through her/the staff. she replied “WELL they are back to back with clients” with the rudest tone and uncaring Manner! I get the vets can be busy but the way she said it with that attitude was just not ok. Won’t be going back!

I would rate forest glen hosp. 10 stars if I could. I've  been going there with my cat muffin many times it's a great place and I highly recommend  this place They took great care of muffin the doctors and staff are wonderful and professional. Muffin was 19 1/2 yrs old she recently passed away I took it very hard and still do I received a card from them signed by doctors and staff members which was so nice so you see they really do care

Awesome Animal Hospital! Asalah is great! She was able to get my cat with immediate health concerns in asap. Dr. Whitfield is knowledgeable and compassionate. Very clean establishment, I will be back!

Accommodating, clean, professional, reliable.

Amazing place that makes us feel like family. Asalah and Rebecca always go above and beyond!
Pricey and not always upfront about their  added fee's.
Dog was not well.  Took care of her the same day I called.  Very happy with the care and concern.

Wonderful and very caring staff! This was our first time trying a new vet after going to one for 8 years. Dr. Whitfield was amazing. My fur baby never felt this calm at a vet office. I have no regrets changing my vet.
Great  experience overall. Surpassed my expectations . My puppy was very pleased with Rebecca and Dr. Traci.

I was excited to schedule a wellness appointment to discuss neutering and general pet care, but the rushed nature of the visit left me feeling disappointed. The staff was very kind, but I left wishing for a more thorough and transparent experience.
My baby felt happy with his new doctor.

Unprofessional and Negligent Care

I strongly advise against using this veterinary clinic. Their consistent pattern of negligence and unprofessionalism has made every visit a frustrating experience. The level of disorganization is simply unacceptable for a medical facility caring for our pets.

Inexcusable Administrative Failures: The clinic’s complete lack of follow-up care is alarming. After every single visit, I’ve had to chase them down for basic information that should be automatically provided. They never once proactively communicated test results or sent invoices, forcing me to waste time repeatedly calling them.

Medical Negligence: Most concerning is their repeated failure to perform requested procedures. They forgot to clean my cat’s ears not once, but TWICE in consecutive visits - a clear demonstration of their careless approach to pet care. When they did perform blood tests, they couldn’t even be bothered to analyze the results or contact me about them.

Complete Lack of Professionalism: Their disorganization goes beyond simple oversight - it reflects a systematic failure in their practice. Having to constantly follow up for basic services and documentation is exhausting and unacceptable. This level of incompetence could potentially put pets at risk if important medical issues are overlooked or forgotten.

Save yourself the headache and find a veterinary clinic that actually cares about your pet and values your time. The stress of dealing with their administrative chaos isn’t worth it, and the risk of them forgetting crucial medical procedures is too high.

Geez… I don't even know where to begin. My partner and I are so grateful for Forest Glen despite the final outcome of this story. In February of this year, we brought home two cats: Piper and Penny. We decided to bring them to Forest Glenn on recommendation from a friend's mom. Funny enough, I had once gone to FGAH on their dog's behalf once to pick up some medication before they closed! So, it made sense to keep things "within the family."

Penny picked up ringworm while she was in the shelter, so she had to go back to FGAH shortly after the cats' initial checkups. She was a bear to take into the vet, but with the hospital's help we found that a small dose of gabapentin helped make things all the easier. Administering oral medicine to a cat for the first time is pretty distressing, but the staff really helped alleviate a lof of he pain points and anxiety around it for us. The ringworm treatment process was a huge pain point for weeks, but we got there eventually and Penny was cured in due time.

Much to our dismay, Penny ended up needing to go back to FGAH early this December on account of some swollen lymph nodes. Dr. Whitfield opted to run some initial blood tests and to do an x-ray. The information from those gave rise to more questions that answers, so we sent out for a FUO blood test and were told to get an ultrasound on Penny's abdomen. Ultimately, both of those routes yielded fruitless results as well—but that was no fault of Dr. Whitfield and the team at FGAH. Everyone was proactive and thorough in trying to figure out what was going on.

In due time, Penny stopped eating and drinking. We ended up having to put her down in the end, but the *entire* staff at FGAH was so helpful along the way. I am embarrassed to say that literally every person at the clinic likely knew about Penny's case, especially since my partner and I swamped them with updates on her health over the course of a week and a half. I have nothing but love for Colin and the other receptionists who answered so many distraught—and, eventually, grieving—phone calls.

We will continue to gladly take Penny's sister, Piper, to Forest Glen Animal Hospital as well as any future pets who may or may not join our small family in the future. Thank you to Dr. Whitfield and everyone else who did their best to help us try and save our sweet Penny.

Awesome first vet visit/introductory visit with my two pets. Everyone I spoke with in setting up the appt and at the appointment was friendly, competent and professional and they made the whole process very easy. My dogs are both a bit anxious and the vet tech and vet both did a great job helping them relax for the examination and to be given some shots. Both dogs were notably less stressed than they have been at other vet appts in the past at other places. Very happy to have this be our new vet.
Excellent service for my dog. They treat dogs and humans with respect and professionalism!
Very caring and conscientious staff. The visit was very thorough and informative. Forest Glen goes above and beyond.🌟 …

As any pet parent, I make sure to make my research before taking my pets anywhere. I heard from multiple neighbors and coworkers that this location was great and I should call. I spoke with Brenda who kept telling me she didn’t know every time I asked any question regarding services/procedures and when I asked to speak to anyone else she initially said it’s no possible and then obliged at the end. The entire time she was talking to me in a condescending voice, which is completely inappropriate . I honestly don’t understand why anyone would do business with this place- customer service is a clear indication of how they treat your pets. If they can’t give you any information regarding the services and well being of your pet- I would highly advise searching elsewhere because this definitely raises several red flags.

Please view other low star reviews to see this isn’t the first bad experience with the front desk.
Thank you so much, Rebecca, for the review. Henry is such a cutie, and it's always a pleasure when he visits!
Thank you so much, Joel. We are glad your experience at our hospital was positive. All our best!
Forest Glen Animal Hospital always takes incredible care of our collie, Shiloh.

Hi there,

I wanted to share a wonderful experience I had with Forest Glen Animal Hospital. Recently, I found a little kitten, Onyx, who quickly became attached to me. I decided to adopt him and knew it was time for his first vet visit.

From the moment I walked in, I was impressed by the receptionist's helpfulness and efficiency. She was able to schedule a same-day appointment, which was a huge relief.

The entire staff was incredibly friendly and professional.

Onyx received his initial vaccinations, deworming treatment, and a stool check for parasites. We were also able to schedule a follow-up appointment for three weeks.

I was even more impressed when the vet called the next day to inform me that Onyx had tested positive for a parasite.

To my surprise, the medication was already ordered and ready for pickup within a couple of hours.

The speed and efficiency of the clinic were truly remarkable. Not only that, but the prices were reasonable and they offered several options to choose from.

It's clear that the staff at Forest Glen are passionate about their work, and I felt confident leaving Onyx in their care.

Thank you again for providing such excellent service.

Best regards,

Chris & Onyx
Always so friendly and take such good care of my babies
They were very kind and understanding
